REPAIR THE SUPPLIED NORTH/BACK RUN SHEET ANATOMICAL LEFT/RIGHT COSTUME. Every figure remains straight NORTH BACK view with face and chest hidden. In BACK view, anatomical RIGHT is on VIEWER RIGHT, so the BARE RIGHT THIGH AND DRESS SLIT MUST BE ON VIEWER RIGHT. Anatomical LEFT is on VIEWER LEFT, so LEFT leg is DARK-COVERED and LEFT hand STAFF is on VIEWER LEFT. The existing back sheet wrongly exposes the viewer-left thigh: explicitly move that slit/bare upper thigh to viewer RIGHT and cover viewer-left thigh. This is a fresh anatomical repaint, not a horizontal mirror: the staff must stay viewer LEFT and crown/hair/feathers must retain their detail. In both top cells, the two contact boots alternate while viewer-RIGHT bare leg stays anatomically RIGHT. Six back-view poses only. 

CRITICAL SPRITE-SHEET SPACING: Six SMALL complete thumbnail characters on a mostly EMPTY TRANSPARENT canvas. Two columns by three rows. If canvas is about1222x1287, each cell is611x429 and each FULL character including all wing and staff tips must be under250pixels wide and250pixels tall, CENTERED in its own cell, with at least80pixels empty space above and below and150pixels empty space left/right. Do NOT fill the cells. Never let any crown, staff tip, feather or hem approach a cell border. The reference art must be SHRUNK to a thumbnail within each cell, not copied at full size. This generous empty spacing is mandatory. The second image is the existing NORTH RUN sheet for camera/feather detail only; correct its wrongly sided slit: use its character proportions and equipment, but draw the requested new camera and new poses. 

Use the supplied local character artwork as the identity reference, and newly draw a SIX-POSE RUN animation contact sheet of this SAME adult ICE QUEEN boss. Preserve her pale adult face, long SILVER HAIR and ornate SILVER CROWN, fitted BLACK-and-GOLD breastplate/armor, long VIOLET-BLACK flowing dress, exactly TWO large violet feather wings attached solidly to the back, and exactly ONE purple-and-gold staff firmly gripped in her anatomical LEFT hand. The dress slit exposes ONLY her anatomical RIGHT upper thigh. Both legs must be clearly traceable from each hip to its own knee, ankle and boot: the LEFT thigh has dark fabric/stocking, the RIGHT thigh has pale skin at the slit. No limb switches or missing hidden support leg. Same ornamentation, body proportions and feather-wing anatomy throughout; fine painted dark-fantasy game sprite rendering with mature realistic anatomy and mythic-tier boss detail. Full staff, crown, both wings, hem and BOTH boots always inside the frame.

This correction is about GENUINELY OPPOSITE ANATOMICAL SUPPORT, not six versions of the same leading bare thigh. The layout is TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, with matching opposite contacts SIDE BY SIDE to make the difference unambiguous. The six squares are independent fresh skeletal poses, not copies, mirror flips or whole-body shifts. LEFT COLUMN is first half of stride: TOP-LEFT: anatomical RIGHT boot contacts flat on the invisible ground ahead of pelvis, RIGHT knee extended, LEFT boot is flexed behind and clearly OFF the ground; MIDDLE-LEFT: RIGHT boot supports under pelvis with compressed knee, LEFT covered knee and LEFT boot swing visibly FORWARD and UP with clear air below; BOTTOM-LEFT: short FLIGHT, LEFT covered leg extended forward/down while RIGHT exposed slit leg extends back/up, both boots above the invisible ground. RIGHT COLUMN is second half of stride: TOP-RIGHT: anatomical LEFT covered leg extends FORWARD and LEFT boot contacts flat ahead of pelvis, RIGHT exposed slit knee bends BACK and RIGHT boot is visibly OFF ground; MIDDLE-RIGHT: LEFT boot supports under pelvis, RIGHT pale thigh/knee and RIGHT boot swing visibly FORWARD and UP with air below; BOTTOM-RIGHT: short FLIGHT, RIGHT bare-thigh leg extended forward/down, LEFT covered leg extends back/up, both boots above the invisible ground. Do not draw the bare RIGHT thigh as the planted leading leg in both top cells. Show an obvious DIFFERENT support foot in top-left vs top-right. These column halves will be played left-column top-to-bottom, then right-column top-to-bottom. Keep staff with LEFT hand through all phases, subtle shoulder counterrotation, recognizable weight over planted boot, bent toe-off and ankle articulation. Skirt panels separate enough to reveal both lower legs during stride while remaining a long ornate gown. Hair, feathers and cloth trail behind and follow through differently in each pose. Wings stay attached and do not replace legs or hide the support exchange. The character RUNS on feet, not levitates or hovers.

Single fixed orthographic/isometric camera per sheet, identical camera and facing in every cell. Small whole figures with VERY LARGE empty transparent gutters: all visible pixels fit within the central 50 percent width and central 65 percent height of each of the six equal cells. Align each cell's invisible ground baseline at about 84 percent of its height; planted soles sit there and flight soles are a little above it. One connected full character silhouette per cell. No overlap of full bounding boxes. TRUE RGBA transparency, alpha0 background. No visible floor, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no text/numbers/grid, no effects/glow/particles/haze, no floating loose feathers, no tiny detached specks. Save the generated PNG locally. Never add walking/attack/death cells. 

Every cell is NORTH straight BACK view, running AWAY from viewer up-screen. Viewer sees only back of crown/head/silver hair, BACK armor and both wing roots, no face or front breastplate. Toes run up-screen, heels toward viewer; wings lie on either side of the spine. Both alternate boots must be visible below the rear hem. Anatomical LEFT hand with staff appears on viewer LEFT.
